name: player_compute_surface_from2_probes
description: Player::ComputeSurfaceFrom2Probes fits a support plane from two above-ground probes, solves player height, and applies the edge-aligned terrain tilt response.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so temporary reuse, x87 ordering, zMath::Vec3Normalize codegen, and terrain caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42c640 validates the first two g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundIndices lookups, pointA candidate height replacement, old-plane pointB height solve, perpendicular pointC construction, pointB candidate replacement, ComputeTriangleNormal, new-plane player height solve, support-edge normalization, tilt scale dot product, and ApplyTerrainTilt call.
The native smoke verifies the two-sample normal, solved player height, tilt impulse, and gravity-scaled projectile velocity side effects.
